summary: BackgroundPlayer freezes on empty segments (bug: startPlayback() line 654-656 returns early leaving state=.playing with no player). Root cause: duplicate segment-chaining logic in both players. Solution: Both players use SegmentIterator (AsyncIterator) that handles empty detection, announcements, segmentPause delays, and cancel().
